name: Remifentanil
executiveSummary: Ultrashort opioid. Adult: **0.05–0.2 mcg/kg/min**. Pediatrics: bolus **0.5 mcg/kg** → **0.1–0.3 mcg/kg/min**. NICU: **0.05–0.25 mcg/kg/min** — anesthesia/neonatology only.
indications:
## Indications

- Adjunct to general anesthesia; sedation/analgesia with secured airway.

## Precautions

- Apnea, chest wall rigidity, bradycardia, hypotension.
- **Not epidural/intrathecal** (glycine in formulation).

> Specialist use only.

pediatrico.dose: 0.5 mcg/kg bolus over 30 s. Maintenance: 0.1–0.3 mcg/kg/min
pediatrico.notes: SPECIALIST USE ONLY. Do not give epidural or intrathecal (glycine in the formulation may cause neurotoxicity).

neonatal.dose: Infusion **0.05–0.25 mcg/kg/min** continuous IV; rare bolus **0.5–1 mcg/kg** slow — anesthesia/neonatology only with secured airway.
neonatal.notes: Titrate to response; high apnea/rigidity risk.

stability:
## Stability

- Reconstitute per package insert; use within 24 h.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Apnea, nausea, bradyarrhythmia, hypotension, respiratory depression. Higher frequency of chest wall rigidity. See opioid analgesics section.
